run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-15T12:16:49Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend RequestErrorRate alert is the visible top of one failing path: frontend POST /api/checkout -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder -> checkout's HTTP POST to shipping /get-quote -> shipping's client span 'POST quote' toward the quote service. Errors begin at the step ending 12:16:49Z (frontend) and 12:17:49Z (shipping, checkout) and, over 12:17:49-12:32:49Z, about 82% of shipping's 'POST quote' spans carry STATUS_CODE_ERROR (205.00 error vs 45.08 unset) while the quote service records no error-status spans and logs only 'Calculated quote'. During the same interval Chaos Mesh Schedule/otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition spawns a NetworkChaos object every minute and logs 'Successfully apply chaos' for exactly otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9 and both quote pods, each lasting ~55 s. The deepest supported cause is therefore an injected network partition between the shipping pod and the quote pods, not an application, resource, crash or rollout fault in frontend, checkout, shipping or quote.

claims.text: Across 2026-11-15T11:16:49Z-12:32:49Z the frontend's error-status spans are confined to one path: increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}) is 283.65 each for frontend spans 'POST', 'POST /api/checkout', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder', whereas frontend 'GET /api/products/{productId}', 'GET /api/cart', 'GET /api/data', 'POST /api/cart', 'grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart', 'grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem', 'grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct' and 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' have no error series (only STATUS_CODE_UNSET).

Onset is at ~12:16:49Z: with increase(...[120s]) per minute, frontend 'POST /api/checkout' error spans are 0 at the steps ending 12:13:49, 12:14:49 and 12:15:49 and first become 41.36 at the step ending 12:16:49, then hold 32-50 per 2 minutes; shipping '/get-quote' and 'POST quote' plus checkout 'HTTP POST' and 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' first show errors at the step ending 12:17:49 and hold 32-49 per 2 minutes.

In 2026-11-15T12:17:49Z-12:32:49Z the shipping client span 'POST quote' (shipping calling the quote service) increased by 205.00 with STATUS_CODE_ERROR versus 45.08 with STATUS_CODE_UNSET, i.e. roughly 82% of its spans in that period are errors; the shipping server span '/get-quote' carries the same error increase.

Before onset the same shipping 'POST quote' span had no errors: per-120s increase was all STATUS_CODE_UNSET (32.0, 52.0, 61.33, 48.0) with 0 errors at the steps ending 12:12:49-12:15:49; from the step ending 12:16:49 onward the UNSET increase collapses to 2.67-14.67 while ERROR rises to 32.0-47.49.

Checkout fails only at the shipping-quote step: in 12:17:49Z-12:32:49Z 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and checkout 'HTTP POST' each increased 205.00 with STATUS_CODE_ERROR vs 45.08 UNSET, while checkout client spans 'oteldemo.CartService/GetCart' (255.45), 'oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert' (506.60), 'oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct' (461.52), 'oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge' (45.08), 'oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart' (45.08) and 'orders publish' (45.08) carry STATUS_CODE_UNSET only, with no error series.

The quote service shows no failures of its own: in 12:17:49Z-12:32:49Z all quote spans total 135.24 and every one is STATUS_CODE_UNSET, with no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series; its 'calculate-quote' p95 from traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket is flat at 1.9 ms at every 300s step from 11:56:49 to 12:26:49; and the newest 40 of 126 log lines of quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b in 12:10-12:30Z are all 'Calculated quote'.

Chaos Mesh in namespace chaos-mesh runs Schedule/otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition: 'Create new object' (reason Spawned) events occur every minute at 12:14:51, 12:15:51, 12:16:51, 12:17:51, 12:18:51, 12:19:51, 12:20:51, 12:21:51, 12:22:51, 12:23:51 and 12:24:51Z, and each spawned NetworkChaos object (e.g. otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition-nh2wt, -wg96t, -w588w) logs 'Experiment has started', then 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9', '... for otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b' and '... for otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt', followed about 55 s later by 'Time up according to the duration' and 'Successfully recover chaos' for the same three pods.

Inside namespace otel-demo the only object-level events in the window are PodNetworkChaos resource updates for exactly three pods - quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b, quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt and shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9 - recurring roughly every 5 minutes from 12:14:51Z through 12:24:51Z.

Pod and workload state show no crash or capacity problem: all 22 otel-demo pods are Running with restartCount 0 and start times 11:40:39Z-11:42:39Z; deployment quote has 2/2 ready replicas and every otel-demo deployment reports Available=True with no unavailableReplicas; CPU CFS throttling is 0 for checkout-5dccddf8bb-vz2zd and stays between 0.018 and 0.23 throttled periods/s for quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b, quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt and shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9.

frontend-proxy records error spans on the failing checkout traffic: in 12:17:49Z-12:32:49Z 'ingress' increased 208.22 with STATUS_CODE_ERROR vs 4681.74 UNSET and 'router frontend egress' 207.15 with STATUS_CODE_ERROR vs 4683.89 UNSET, while before onset its error increase per 300s was only 0-5.56.

The trace store holds no incident-window spans: the sampled frontend spans read start at 1794744052523000-1794744054815000 us (12:00:52-12:00:55Z) with data_as_of 12:00:55Z although the requested window ended 12:32:49Z, so no error span tags or error text from 12:16-12:32Z could be read.

Deepest supported cause: the scheduled Chaos Mesh partition otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition blocks the shipping pod's traffic to both quote pods, so shipping's 'POST quote' client spans end in error while only part of the attempts reach quote (quote records 135.24 spans while shipping attempts about 250 in the same 15 minutes); '/get-quote' then errors to checkout, checkout's PlaceOrder errors to frontend, and frontend's POST /api/checkout errors, which is what RequestErrorRate measures. Onset (~12:16:49Z) follows the first spawned experiment at 12:14:51Z and the fault repeats every minute through 12:24:51Z.

frontend-proxy's 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' error spans are the proxy-side view of those same failed frontend checkout responses rather than an independent frontend-proxy fault: they begin only after onset, they are about 4% of its span volume (208 of roughly 4890 in 15 minutes) which matches the checkout share of frontend traffic, and frontend-proxy has no other failing operation. Unconfirmed by traces because no incident-window spans exist in Jaeger.

Rejected: a quote-service application failure. Quote recorded no STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans (all 135.24 spans in 12:17:49Z-12:32:49Z are UNSET), its 'calculate-quote' p95 stayed at 1.9 ms across the window, and its pod log lines are all 'Calculated quote'; the failures are observed on the caller side (shipping 'POST quote') while arriving calls are served normally.

Rejected: pod crash, restart, OOM/eviction or CPU saturation on frontend, checkout, shipping or quote. All otel-demo pods are Running with 0 restarts, no Evicted/OOMKilled/Unhealthy event exists in otel-demo, deployments report all replicas ready and available, and CFS throttling for these pods is 0.018-0.23 per second with checkout at 0.

Rejected: a rollout or deployment change as the cause. Every otel-demo ReplicaSet, including quote-6b5877698d with both quote pods, was created at 11:40:39Z-11:42:39Z, before the 12:16:49Z onset, and pod start times are 11:40:39Z-11:42:39Z with restartCount 0.

Rejected: the small error counts on ad, recommendation and fraud-detection explain the alert. They were already non-zero before onset (ad 1.11 at the steps ending 12:01:49 and 12:11:49, fraud-detection 1.13 at 12:06:49, recommendation 1.11-1.16 at several steps) and stay at about 1-4 spans per 300s, and none of them lies on the frontend checkout path whose error spans this alert counts.

Other activity in the window belongs to namespace data-recorders, not otel-demo: Job/clickhouse-unified-recorder created pods at 11:59:30Z, 12:00:08Z, 12:01:49Z and 12:24:37Z, a clickhouse-unified-recorder container was stopped at 12:02:15Z, and StatefulSet jaeger-traces-recorder created jaeger-traces-recorder-0 at 11:59:37Z. No otel-demo workload was rolled or restarted at that time.

Counter-evidence against an application fault inside shipping: the 40 newest shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9 log lines in 12:24:38-12:25:19Z contain only 'Requesting quote', 'Sending Quote' and 'Tracking ID Created', no error, warning or exception text, and the pod stayed Running with 0 restarts, so the failure is visible only in the client span status and in how few calls reach quote.

Inspect the Chaos Mesh Schedule/otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition and its child NetworkChaos objects in namespace chaos-mesh (target selectors, direction, loss/partition parameters, duration, schedule history) and confirm whether this fault injection is authorized here; if it is not, suspend or delete the schedule so shipping can reach the quote pods again.

If the injection is intended, alert on the shipping-to-quote leg directly (shipping 'POST quote' error ratio, observed ~82% over 12:17:49-12:32:49Z) and make the checkout path degrade gracefully, because frontend RequestErrorRate is only the consequence of that partition.

gaps: No trace spans exist for the incident window: the newest spans available to this tooling are from 12:00:52-12:00:55Z, so the exact gRPC/HTTP error text and error tags of the failing calls could not be read and the chain is reconstructed from span-metric labels and Kubernetes events, not from parent-child references.

The NetworkChaos/PodNetworkChaos custom resources could not be read (only their events were visible), so the fault's direction, loss/partition percentage, exact selectors and duration configuration remain unknown.
list_prometheus_rules for rule_name RequestErrorRate returned no rules, so the alert expression and threshold could not be verified from this Prometheus.
The change_history integration is not integrated in this Run, so who or what created Schedule/otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition could not be checked.
Whether failed checkouts produced customer-visible impact beyond the observed service-side error spans is not verified.
Whether the partition continued after the last visible Chaos Mesh event at 12:24:51Z is unknown; the window extends to 12:32:49Z and later error metrics were only partially readable.
Shipping's pod log was only readable up to 12:25:19Z and only the newest 40 of 428 lines were shown; quote logs were readable up to 12:24:48Z, so later log content is unknown.
next_steps: Read the Chaos Mesh Schedule and NetworkChaos specs in namespace chaos-mesh (otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition) to confirm targets, direction, loss parameters and authorization.
If the experiment is not intended, suspend the schedule and confirm that shipping 'POST quote', checkout PlaceOrder and frontend POST /api/checkout error spans return to zero.
Confirm whether both quote replicas should be targets of the partition, since both quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b and quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt plus shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9 are affected.
Restore trace visibility (Jaeger last returned spans at ~12:00:55Z) so incident-window error details can be inspected directly.
